class.name: NNAngleVector3Sensor
class.brief_description: Measures the unsigned 3D angle between two vectors and maps it to [code]0..1[/code].
class.description: Computes the unsigned angle (from [code]0[/code] to [code]180[/code] degrees) between [member from_vector] and [member to_vector] and normalizes it against [member max_angle_degrees] into a [code]0..1[/code] sensor value. Useful for checking how closely a 3D entity is facing a target or direction.

members.member: Reference direction vector (for example, the entity's facing direction).
Maximum angle in degrees that maps to [code]1.0[/code]. Must be greater than [code]0[/code]. Syncs with [member max_angle_radian].
Maximum angle in radians that maps to [code]1.0[/code]. Must be greater than [code]0[/code]. Syncs with [member max_angle_degrees].
Target direction vector compared against [member from_vector] (for example, the direction toward an enemy).
